description: Search the paid APIs on Autonomo (token prices, new launches, rug-risk checks, wallet portfolios, transaction explainers, page reader and more on Robinhood Chain). Returns each API's slug, price and the path to call. verified means the provider holds the Verified minimum of $AUTONOMO; it isn't a review of the API. Free. Set include_directory to also search Autonomo's directory of 4K+ x402 projects on other networks (listed for reference; call_api only pays Autonomo gateways).

include_directory.description: Also search the x402 directory (other projects and networks).

query.description: What the API should do, e.g. 'token risk' or 'wallet holdings'. Leave empty to list all.

name: find_apis
title: Find Autonomo APIs
